owner_go: kt, 2026-11-17: 'go' (freeze F3 as the single candidate and run the final window once, reporting whatever comes out)
candidate: QQQ hourly dip-buy + VIX/VIX3M gate + F3_EVENT (v2 definition, unchanged)
also_reported_for_context: A_base (v1 chosen base rule, no filter)

rule.gate: VIX/VIX3M close of the previous session < 1.0
rule.entry: open of the bar after the signal bar
rule.exit: after H bars (open of next bar) or when a bar closes <= entry*(1-3%)
rule.F3_EVENT: skip entries whose ENTRY DAY (ET) has an event in the list below

window.lookback_warmup_bars_from: 2025-11-03 (lookback only; no signal before the start)

hand_added_event_days_et.event: Non Farm Payrolls (Oct) = BLS Employment Situation, 8:30 ET
Inflation Rate MoM (Oct) = BLS Consumer Price Index, 8:30 ET

calendar_notes: The R2 economic_calendar.csv (uploaded 1 Nov 2026) ends 5 Nov 2026; its last Fed decision is 28 Oct 2026. No FOMC decision is scheduled 6-12 Nov 2026 (next: 8-9 Dec), so only the two BLS dates above are added.
The other event dates in the window come from that Flywheel calendar and were NOT cross-checked one by one against official calendars.
evidence_so_far: F3 passed IS and Selection (v2), failed the 2020-2023 older-history test (v2.1); no v3 variant passed. Candidate chosen by the pre-agreed rule (F3 is the default when nothing else is eligible).
reporting_rule: The final-window result is reported exactly as it comes out, including by-quarter, 2x cost, buy-and-hold and top-3 share. No parameter, filter or date list changes after this file is hashed. The runner writes a lock and refuses a second pass.
